class.name: Weather
class.brief_description: The weather of a level: blends between weather types and runs the weather effects.
class.description: Picks a weather type from its [member library] (or [member custom_profile] when [member weather] is [code]"Custom"[/code]) and blends to it over [member transition_time]. Every frame it drives the [WindServer] from the blended [WeatherProfile], updates the surface wetness, and runs its [member effects]: lighting, and in later versions sky, rain, haze, lightning and sound. The node runs in the editor too, so the viewport shows the weather. Every scene value the weather changes (sun, environment, exposure, wind) goes through [method drive], which remembers the scene's own value and puts it back before the scene is saved and when the node leaves the tree. A value edited in the inspector while the weather drives it becomes the new base the weather works from. [b]Weather types:[/b] a new type is a new [WeatherProfile] in a [WeatherLibrary]; no code. [b]New effects:[/b] extend [WeatherEffect] and add it to [member effects]. Surface shaders can read the global shader parameters [code]weather_wetness[/code] (0 to 1, lags behind the rain) and [code]weather_rain[/code] (0 to 1, the rain now, with gust bursts). [codeblock] var weather := get_tree().get_first_node_in_group(&"weather") as Weather weather.change_weather("Storm") # Blends over transition_time. weather.change_weather("Fog", 30.0) # Over 30 seconds; 0 switches at once. var profile := WeatherProfile.new() # Any settings: becomes Custom. profile.rain_intensity = 0.5 weather.change_profile(profile) [/codeblock]

method.name: change_profile
method.description: Blends to [param profile] over [param duration] seconds ([member transition_time] when negative, at once when [code]0.0[/code]). A profile that is not in the library becomes the [member custom_profile] and [member weather] becomes [code]"Custom"[/code].

method.name: change_weather
method.description: Blends to the weather type named [param name] (a profile's [member WeatherProfile.display_name] in the library, or [code]"Custom"[/code]) over [param duration] seconds ([member transition_time] when negative, at once when [code]0.0[/code]).

method.name: create_default_effects
method.description: Returns new instances of the built-in effects, in the order they run. A new [Weather] node starts with these.

method.name: drive
method.description: Sets [param property] of [param object] to [param value] and remembers the object's own value, to be restored by [method restore_scene]. Effects use it for every scene value they change.

method.name: get_base
method.description: The scene's own value of a property the weather drives: the value before the weather first changed it, or the value something else set since the weather last wrote it.

method.name: get_camera_attributes
method.description: The camera attributes of the [WorldEnvironment] the weather drives, if any.

method.name: get_current
method.description: The blended profile being shown. Read it; don't change it.

method.name: get_effective_library
method.description: [member library], or the built-in [method WeatherLibrary.get_default] when it is empty.

method.name: get_effective_quality
method.description: The quality level in use: [member quality], or the [code]weather/quality[/code] project setting when [member quality] is [constant QUALITY_AUTO].

method.name: get_environment
method.description: The [Environment] the weather drives, if any.

method.name: get_gust
method.description: The gust strength at the camera, from [code]0.0[/code] to [code]1.0[/code] (see [method WindServer.get_gust]).

method.name: get_horizon_light
method.description: The light of the sky near the horizon in linear color, at the sky's current brightness. Rain, haze and distant fog take this color.

method.name: get_profile
method.description: The profile of the weather type [param name]: the library's (shared, so [method Resource.duplicate] it before changing it from code) or [member custom_profile] for [code]"Custom"[/code].

method.name: get_rain_amount
method.description: The rain now, from [code]0.0[/code] to [code]1.0[/code]: the profile's rain intensity, heavier in gusts (see [member gust_rain_bursts]).

method.name: get_sky_energy
method.description: The sky's own brightness, read from the sky material when the node enters the tree.

method.name: get_sky_horizon_color
method.description: The sky's horizon color (sRGB), read from the sky material or the background color when the node enters the tree.

method.name: get_sky_overcast_color
method.description: The grey the sky turns under an overcast (sRGB): the sky shader's [code]overcast_color[/code] parameter when it has one.

method.name: get_sun
method.description: The [DirectionalLight3D] the weather drives: [member sun_path], or the first one in the scene.

method.name: get_sun_through_clouds
method.description: How much direct sunlight gets below the clouds, from [code]0.0[/code] to [code]1.0[/code].

method.name: get_target
method.description: The profile the weather is blending to (or showing).

method.name: get_time
method.description: Seconds the weather has been running.

method.name: get_view_camera
method.description: The camera the weather follows: the active camera in the game, the 3D editor viewport's camera in the editor.

method.name: get_weather_name
method.description: The display name of the profile being shown or blended to.

method.name: get_weather_names
method.description: The weather types to choose from: the library's profile names, then [code]"Custom"[/code].

method.name: get_wetness
method.description: How wet surfaces are, from [code]0.0[/code] to [code]1.0[/code]. Rises in rain over [member wetting_time] and falls over [member drying_time].

method.name: get_wind
method.description: The wind at the camera, in m/s.

method.name: get_world_environment
method.description: The [WorldEnvironment] the weather drives: [member world_environment_path], or the first one in the scene.

method.name: is_previewing
method.description: [code]false[/code] in the editor while [member preview_in_editor] is off.

method.name: next_weather
method.description: Blends to the next weather type in [method get_weather_names]. Skips [code]"Custom"[/code] while there is no custom profile.

method.name: release
method.description: Gives a property back to the scene: puts back the value it had before [method drive] took it over, and stops tracking it. Effects call it from [method WeatherEffect._stop] for every property they drove, so a stopped effect leaves the scene as it found it.

method.name: restore_scene
method.description: Puts every scene value the weather drives back to the scene's own value. The next frame drives them again.

method.name: set_horizon_light
method.description: Sets the value returned by [method get_horizon_light] for this frame. The lighting effect calls it with the dimmed sky.

method.name: set_sky_colors
method.description: Sets the colors and energy returned by [method get_sky_horizon_color], [method get_sky_overcast_color] and [method get_sky_energy]. The sky effect calls it every frame, so effects that run after it (haze, rain) can tint themselves to match the sky.

method.name: set_wetness
method.description: Sets how wet surfaces are, for example to start a level after rain.

members.member: The settings used when [member weather] is [code]"Custom"[/code], edited right here. Picking [code]"Custom"[/code] without one starts from the weather showing.
Seconds for surfaces to dry after the rain stops.
The effects the weather runs every frame, in order. Each is a [WeatherEffect] with its own settings. Remove one to turn it off, or add your own.
How far gusts swing the wind's direction at full gustiness, in degrees (sets [member WindServer.direction_swing_degrees]).
How much heavier the rain gets in gusts. [code]0.0[/code] keeps it steady.
The weather types to choose from. Empty uses [method WeatherLibrary.get_default].
If [code]true[/code], the editor viewport shows the weather. If [code]false[/code], the scene's own values are restored.
The effects' quality level. [constant QUALITY_AUTO] uses the [code]weather/quality[/code] project setting.
The sun the weather drives. Empty finds the first [DirectionalLight3D] in the scene.
Default blend time between weather types, in seconds. In the editor, changing [member weather] switches at once.
The weather type: a profile name from the library, or [code]"Custom"[/code]. Changing it blends to the new type over [member transition_time].
Seconds for surfaces to get fully wet in heavy rain (longer in light rain).
The [WorldEnvironment] the weather drives. Empty finds the first one in the scene.

signal.name: weather_changed
signal.description: Emitted when the weather starts blending to [param profile].
